title: OVMS Metric Status Mix
dataSources: Tesla vehicle/charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), TeslaMate MQTT/Postgres, OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smartcar API (`smartcar:vehicle`), EV charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Teslafi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / manufacturer APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ovms:metric
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(stream_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the Open Vehicles metric feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `stream_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It always the overall mood of your Open Vehicles metric feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
